meta.title: Compression tiers & toolbox
meta.description: Five-tier context compression plus an optical toolbar: the vial above the composer shows live usage and the system / tools / messages split, the pixel companions next to it can be poked and switched off, and the appearance page offers four palettes and three motion tiers. Tiers switch from the Compression tiers panel in the sidebar and apply to every preset engine at once, no restart, with automatic pressure compaction kept on each tier; the six pages of that panel also edit the global AGENTS.md and the AGENTS.md of each registered workspace, detect or download four managed components (GitHub CLI, git, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python — resumable, rollback on failure, managed copy first on PATH), and show GitHub token scopes and the network check; the repository pill above the input decides where github_push publishes. Tools: compression_tiers, compression_context, compression_compact, github_push. It downloads those components from GitHub releases, gyan.dev and python-build-standalone; with the plugin off, tiers stop syncing, managed directories leave PATH, and the tools and panel disappear. Limits: tiers assume 256k-token windows or more and only preset-isolated engines are updated; the vial and companions read official context projections and show a dash when they are missing.
